request.description: Creates the scoring model and its first draft. Staff only: credit analysts make, another staff member approves, then it is published (ops leads approve too). `content`: `scope` (`segments`, `subSegments`; the most specific published model wins), `factors[]` (`key`, `label`, `max`, `method` `bands` (first passing `when` gives `points`; an unknown band stops and counts as missing) or `linear` (`attr` from → to scaled to `max`), `missing`: `insufficient` (no score at all), `exclude_renormalise` or `zero`, optional `requiresConsent` purpose and `minProvenance`), `attentionBelowPct`, `bands[]` (`min` 0–100 with labels, one at 0). Thresholds are a credit decision; nothing is seeded.
